text:
marta_finance: Heads up  found a mismatch on OrbisBio private renewal. Invoice OB-2025-011 billed platform fee at 11% (multi-year discount missing) and Support Tier set to 'Enterprise Plus' instead of contracted 'Enterprise'.
leo_am: Can you drop the invoice lines?
marta_finance: Billed:
```
1) OnPrem License - Enterprise - $210,000
2) Platform Fee (11%) - $23,100
3) Support (Enterprise Plus) - $52,500
```
Contract/SOW expects:
```
2) Platform Fee (8%) - $16,800  # multi-year 3yr discount applied
3) Support (Enterprise) - $26,250
```

marta_finance: Delta = platform $6,300 + support $26,250 = $32,550 pre-tax. Invoice auto-issued and customer paid.
anjali_ops: Quick check: renewal-import job REN-3yr-2025 had a miss: discount flag not set when term_months >= 36 for private renewals after we merged multi-year rules. Ticket OPS-1654.
leo_am: Customer emailed saying invoice looks double-charged for support. They're upset. We need a customer-facing fix and internal remediation.
marta_finance: billing_bot: preview credit memo for $32,550 and options to apply credit to next invoice or refund ACH. Show ledger impact.
billing_bot: CREDIT PREVIEW -> Account ORBISBIO | Total Credit: $32,550 | Tax: TBD | Outstanding: $0.00 | If applied -> account balance -$32,550 credit. Reply `apply_credit` or `refund_ach`.
leo_am: Customer prefers a credit and a short apologetic note + 25% first-month credit on Dedicated burst for goodwill. Ok?
vp_finance: Credits > $25k need VP sign-off. Also require settlement ack per legal if >$25k. Provide remediation plan.
marta_finance: Remediation plan: 1) Patch REN-3yr-2025 to enforce multi-year discount for term_months>=36 (done) 2) Run a 90-day audit for similar misses (OPS-1654) 3) Add unit test to renewal-import (OPS-1655). RevRec will reverse the over-recognized revenue tied to support lines.
legal: We'll prepare a short settlement acknowledgment for OrbisBio to sign.
vp_finance: Approve issuing credit memo $32,550 to OrbisBio, apply to next invoice, and include goodwill: 25% first-month Dedicated burst credit. Capture approval: "VP Finance 1991122334 approved credit for OrbisBio due to renewal-import discount flag bug; require signed settlement ack."
marta_finance: Approved. Creating credit memo CM-2025-045 and applying to account. Attaching settlement doc and AM note to the customer.
leo_am: Customer signed settlement and confirmed credit applied. Reply: "Thanks for swift resolution. Please confirm the discount fix."
anjali_ops: OPS-1654 fix merged and deployed; OPS-1655 unit tests added. Running audit now.
marta_finance: Closing thread. Will update if audit finds additional impacted accounts.
